description: Monero output distribution: how many spendable outputs fall into each ring-size bucket, read from our own monerod. This is the anonymity-set side of Monero that free explorers rarely expose. When to use: reasoning about Monero privacy - how large the spendable-output set is at a given height. Do not use: to guess a 'privacy score' (we return raw counts only). Boundary: monerod's distribution data lags the chain tip by roughly 5,000 blocks, so the default range is 5,010 to 5,000 blocks back and the response states the real height and the lag. Returns: tip_height, queried_range, data_lags_tip_by_blocks, start_height, outputs_before_start, distribution[] with the raw per-bucket counts.
name: xmr_get_output_distribution
